reviewer: Codex assistant /root/citation_design_review, manual visual review of the existing original-page rendering; not a human reviewer
method: Read the original rendered page and transcribe its complete two-level header paths and first three state rows. Existing parser results were not used to choose values or header associations. No parser/model calls were executed for this annotation. Stored page dimensions were read only as provenance metadata.
population: Three named development rows on one page, selected around a previously observed failure. These are not held-out cases or exhaustive labels for the table.

source.printed_footer_note: The frozen PDF fixture itself has one physical page; the printed count is not its physical page count.

coordinate_system: Approximate normalized [x0,y0,x1,y1] fractions of original page width/height, top-left origin. Boxes were estimated visually for localization, not measured as exact cell boundaries and not suitable for an IoU accuracy claim.

table.column_index_convention: Zero-based, end-exclusive. Row values align one-to-one with header_paths, including the State / Territory label at index 0.
table.ungrouped_header_note: The colored Permit-through-Admin columns have no printed parent label; do not invent Base as source text. State / Territory and Totals are single header paths.
table.blank_convention: JSON null denotes a visibly empty data cell. Literal zero is the string 0. The two Rentals cells are empty in each annotated state row; footer zeros must not be copied into them.

case.question: In "background-checks.pdf", report Alabama's Permit, Handgun, Long Gun and Totals values for November 2015. Do these statistics represent firearms sold?

original_question.note: The original question also asks whether these statistics are firearms sold. Preserve that fifth semantic point separately from the four table lookups; do not silently shorten the question.

document_controls.expected: The statistics count firearm background checks initiated through NICS, not the number of firearms sold; there is no one-to-one correlation between a check and a sale.
required_phrases: number of firearm background checks initiated through the NICS
do not represent the number of firearms sold
a one-to-one correlation cannot be made between a firearm background check and a firearm sale
document_controls.text_matching_note: Match these substantive phrases after whitespace normalization; no punctuation at the omitted phrase boundaries is implied.

other_corpus_controls.scope: Existing two-column reading-order, abstract fact and caption checkpoints; no visual figure understanding.
Existing native-text logistics and image omission checkpoints; no OCR of the embedded screenshot.
Existing merged benchmark headers, stated values and cross-page prose checkpoints; preserve qualifiers rather than comparing number presence alone.
Existing amount, period/date header and units associations. This control does not grant explicit fiscal-Q4/year labels absent from a cited table.

rubric.cell_text: Trim outer whitespace and collapse internal whitespace runs to one ASCII space. Otherwise retain digits, thousands separators, signs, asterisks, punctuation and case. A value appearing elsewhere on the page is not a correct cell.
rubric.row_association: Each expected cell must belong to its annotated State / Territory row and its exact normalized header path. Moving an Alabama value to another row, or matching a coincidental value in another column, fails association even if the string is present.
rubric.header_hierarchy: Normalize whitespace in each path component separately and compare the complete ordered path. Preserve merged parent spans and child distinctions. The ungrouped Handgun column differs from Pre-Pawn > Handgun and every other repeated Handgun header.
rubric.blank_preservation: An explicit blank cell may be represented as null or empty/whitespace-only cell text while retaining its row and column position. Missing columns, zero, a shifted neighboring value, or a footer aggregate do not count as a preserved blank.
rubric.page_mapping: Every annotated row, associated header and document control must map to source physical page 1 (page_index 0), with source identity and a valid local source span. Use the approximate boxes for manual localization only; do not report exact coordinate overlap or PDF-byte offsets.
rubric.aggregation: Report separately the 66 nonblank numeric matches, 6 explicit blanks, 3 row labels, 25 complete header paths, 6 merged parent groups, 4 original Alabama table facts, and document controls. Also report joint exact row success for each of the three rows. Do not hide association errors inside token-presence scores.
rubric.scope_limit: No score or correctness claim is authorized for unannotated state rows, the footer totals, any unannotated corpus page, or held-out tables. Reusing development checkpoints cannot establish general parser accuracy.
